market_summary: Bred rally i AI-relaterede vækstnavne (MRVL, FLEX, GLW) fortsætter, men flere positioner er nu teknisk overkøbte, hvilket øger risikoen for kortsigtet konsolidering. TDG's kursfald trods stærkt regnskab er et opmærksomhedspunkt uden bekræftet fundamental brist. Kontantbufferen er meget stram i dag ($2.582), så GLW tages i gevinst nær kursmål for at finansiere en enkelt, disciplineret ny position (L) uden at bryde 2.500 USD-minimumskravet.

decisions.name: Nucor
decisions.reasoning: Stærk opadgående trend forbliver intakt (pris +37.8% over SMA200); ny Vulcraft-kapacitetsudvidelse signalerer ledelsestillid, og ingen stop- eller tesebrud.
bull: A new $59M Vulcraft Indiana capacity expansion signals management confidence in demand, alongside a strong uptrend (20d +18.2%) near 52w highs.
Price is well above both SMAs (+9.8%/+37.8%), confirming a durable long-term trend.
bear: Steel is a cyclical commodity business; pricing swings outside Nucor's control remain the primary risk to the current trend.
New capacity investment adds near-term capex that could pressure free cash flow if demand growth disappoints.

investment_plan.thesis: Buy-the-dip i bekræftet bulltrend: KeyBanc-upgrade + Q2-guidance-beat + tarif-rygvind giver asymmetrisk risk/reward.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $222.14 (2x ATR). Sælg ved stålpriskollaps under tarifsatser eller globalt recessions-signal.

decisions.name: Nasdaq, Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Tæt på kursmål ($96.68 vs. $98), men bull-tesen (tokenisering/dark-pool-M&A) er uændret og ingen stop-brud — lader positionen løbe mod målet.
bull: Nasdaq is expanding into digital-liquidity/tokenization via the LeveL Markets dark-pool acquisition, a strategic growth lever.
Steady uptrend (20d +5.2%, price above both SMAs) with Polymarket reportedly hiring Nasdaq veterans, a sign of industry talent migration toward its space.
bear: Peer Cboe fell 22% over three months, a potential read-through of exchange-sector headwinds that could eventually pressure Nasdaq too.
Integration risk on the LeveL Markets and other recent M&A could weigh on near-term execution.

investment_plan.thesis: Bekræftet teknisk vending + rekordstærkt IPO-halvår og AI-platform-adoption forbliver intakt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $90.38 (2x ATR). Sælg ved close under stop eller markant eskalering af perpetual-futures-konkurrencetrussel.

decisions.name: TransDigm Group
decisions.reasoning: Stærkt regnskab men aktien solgte alligevel af — teknisk svaghed (MACD negativ) uden bekræftet fundamental årsag; holder da tesen (makro-selloff, ikke selskabsspecifik) endnu ikke er modbevist.
bull: Aerospace-aftermarket parts pricing power has historically compounded returns strongly over the long term (per coverage of its multi-decade track record).
Q3 earnings reportedly 'soared,' evidencing continued strong underlying fundamentals despite the stock's reaction.
bear: The stock sold off despite strong earnings ('earnings soared, so why did the stock sink'), signalling the market may be pricing in guidance or valuation concerns not yet public.
MACD is negative (-5.19) and price is -15.4% off its 52w high, confirming near-term technical weakness.

investment_plan.thesis: Makro-/oliedrevet industriselloff, ikke selskabsspecifik svaghed - høj-margin aerospace-eftermarkedsforretning forbliver intakt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $1166.19 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller brud på Zacks-opgraderingens antagelser.

decisions.name: Marvell Technology
decisions.reasoning: AI-hukommelsesrallyet fortsætter med bekræftet sektormomentum, men RSI 75.2/stoch 92.4 er stærkt overkøbt — holder positionen men følger tæt for reversal-signaler.
bull: AI memory/networking rally driving strong momentum (20d +20.2%, RSI 75.2), directly confirmed by headline coverage of the surge.
Sector-wide AI infrastructure demand (alongside Micron/Sandisk) supports a durable near-term tailwind.
bear: RSI 75.2 and stoch 92.4 are firmly overbought, raising the risk of a sharp pullback if the AI-memory trade cools.
A rally driven by sector-wide sentiment rather than company-specific news is more vulnerable to a broad reversal.

investment_plan.thesis: Sektor-bred sympati-selloff i chip-komplekset giver dyb oversolgt entry i en langsigtet intakt AI-silicon-vækstcase.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $162.53 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Kina-hukommelseskonkurrencen viser sig strukturel, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: 3M Company
decisions.reasoning: Beat-and-raise-regnskab og Azure-partnerskab holder tesen intakt; teknisk billede solidt nær 52-ugers høj trods vage 'warning signs'-omtale.
bull: Positive MACD (+4.9) and a 20-day gain of +13.3% show a solid uptrend, with transportation/electronics segment strength cited as a driver.
Price sits just -2.5% off its 52w high, confirming the trend is intact near highs.
bear: 3M was flagged in a list of Dow stocks carrying 'warning signs,' suggesting some analysts see risk beneath the recent strength.
As an industrial conglomerate, legacy litigation and cyclical exposure remain latent risks not fully visible in near-term technicals.

investment_plan.thesis: Ægte beat-and-raise-regnskab plus nyt Azure-partnerskab holder det tekniske billede bullish.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $167.21 (2x ATR). Sælg ved PFAS/høreværns-retssagsrisiko eskalerer yderligere, eller tilbagegang i organisk vækst/guidance.

decisions.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
decisions.reasoning: Ny all-time-high efter opjusteret 2026-guidance bekræfter tesen; fortsat momentum og pipeline-katalysatorer nærmer sig.
bull: Stock hit an all-time high after raising 2026 guidance, with coverage suggesting it could still be ~8% undervalued.
Positive momentum (MACD +10.1, RSI 61) and pipeline catalysts nearing suggest further upside potential.
bear: Trading at/near all-time highs leaves less margin of safety if a pipeline catalyst disappoints.
Biotech names carry binary clinical/regulatory risk not fully captured in technical indicators.

investment_plan.thesis: Dybt oversolgt i en teknisk intakt opadgående trend, med Crinetics-opkøb som signal om offensiv pipeline-udvidelse.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $448.95 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Crinetics-opkøbet viser overbetaling/integrationsproblemer, eller ved pipeline-skuffelse.

decisions.name: Flex Ltd.
decisions.reasoning: Tæt på kursmål ($130 vs. $135) med opgraderet guidance på AI-datacenter-efterspørgsel; stoch 94.9 er overkøbt, men tesen er ubrudt — lader positionen løbe mod målet.
bull: Guidance was upgraded on an AI data-center infrastructure push, and momentum confirms it (stoch 94.9, 20d +8.4%).
Strong long-term trend intact, with price still +42.1% above SMA200.
bear: Stochastic at 94.9 signals a technically overbought condition, raising the odds of near-term consolidation.
As a contract manufacturer, Flex's AI-driven upside depends on continued hyperscaler capex, a cyclical dependency.

investment_plan.thesis: Beat-and-raise-regnskab ignoreret af markedet i en bred tech-selloff giver en dybt oversolgt entry.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $85.68 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller fortsat makrodrevet selloff uden bundtegn.

decisions.name: Corning Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Tager gevinst nær kursmål ($173.21 vs. $175) mens aktien er stærkt overkøbt (RSI 75.9, stoch 93.1) og flere kilder flagger den som overvurderet efter en 4.5x 3-års stigning; dagens dom er NEUTRAL, ikke BULL.
bull: Management points to a tariff-resilient strategic structure, and momentum is very strong (20d +13.1%, price +24.5% above SMA200).
AI/optical-fiber infrastructure demand appears to be the driver behind the recent surge.
bear: RSI 75.9 and stoch 93.1 are firmly overbought, and coverage explicitly flags the stock as looking overvalued after a 4.5x three-year gain.
A steep rally into overbought territory raises the risk of profit-taking in the near term.

investment_plan.thesis: Position lukket: gevinst taget nær kursmål mens tekniske og værdiansættelsesmæssige signaler vender fra bullish til neutral/overkøbt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Solgt i dag — profit-take ved kursmål og overkøbte teknikker.

decisions.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Lille urealiseret tab, men AWS/AI-momentum og voksende Anthropic-eksponering holder tesen intakt; ingen stop-brud, forbrugssvækkelse er en overvåget risiko.
bull: Positive momentum (MACD +5.8, price above both SMAs) with AWS/AI capex increasingly framed as a durable earnings driver.
Amazon's stake in Anthropic is now reportedly large enough to move consolidated earnings, an underappreciated value lever.
bear: Goldman Sachs flagged a consumer-spending slowdown as tax-refund tailwinds fade, a direct risk to Amazon's core retail segment.
AI-related capex spending across hyperscalers is a live debate on returns, adding valuation uncertainty.

investment_plan.thesis: Regnskabsdrevet breakout bekræfter AI-monetisering på tværs af cloud og retail; køber en lille startposition inden for det stramme kontantbudget efter dagens CSGP-salg.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $253.07 (2x ATR, lige under dagens breakout-niveau). Sælg ved skarp reversal uden opfølgning eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse.

decisions.name: Walt Disney Company (The)
decisions.reasoning: Ny CEO's konkrete indholdsplan (NFL, Avengers) og konstruktive teknikker (RSI 61, positiv MACD) holder tesen intakt; ingen stop-brud.
bull: New CEO unveiled a concrete forward plan (including a new Avengers trailer) at D23, giving the market a fresh content-slate catalyst.
Technicals are constructive: RSI 61, positive MACD, price only -12.3% off the 52w high.
bear: Leadership-transition execution risk remains elevated in the early stages of a new CEO's tenure.
Streaming competition (Netflix comparisons in coverage) continues to pressure the media segment's margin trajectory.

investment_plan.thesis: NFL-indholdsaftalen og bundle-strategien virker synligt — faldende churn, stigende abonnentvækst og analytiker-kursmålsforhøjelser efter femte regnskabsbeat i træk, mens aktien stadig ligger ~10% i minus for året.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $99.98 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis streaming-bundle-økonomien eller NFL-indholdsomkostninger eroderer marginforbedringen, eller ved skarpt reversal uden opfølgning.

decisions.name: Loews Corporation
decisions.reasoning: Ekstremt oversolgt RSI (9.2) relativt til et mildt 5-dages prisfald efter et solidt Q2-beat (hoteller/rørledninger); lille startposition finansieret af dagens GLW-salg, diversificerer væk fra det allerede tunge Industrials-eksponering.
bull: Q2 profit and revenue grew, driven by strength in hotels and pipelines, a diversified conglomerate beat.
RSI 9.2 is extremely oversold relative to a mild -1.25% 5-day price move, a technical divergence that often precedes a bounce.
bear: Insurance underwriting (via CNA) is softening, a headwind for one of Loews' core segments.
As a scout name outside the top screener tier, conviction and news coverage remain thinner than for top candidates.

investment_plan.thesis: Solidt Q2-beat i hoteller/rørledninger og en ekstremt oversolgt RSI (9.2) relativt til det milde 5-dages fald peger på en teknisk bounce-mulighed i et fundamentalt sundt konglomerat.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $108.22 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis CNA-forsikringsunderwriting svækkes markant yderligere, eller ved brud på RSI-bounce-tesen uden opfølgning.
